external_evidence.label: Frozen G_mfu_crf paired actual-RGB complete-pipeline timing
external_evidence.scope: Three selected input pairs (COCO, PACO-Part, Fundus), two paired rounds in each of two encoding flows: R+Q both freshly encoded, and Q-only with one freshly encoded reference retained in RAM. Twelve paired trials, 24 actually encoded pipelines. Same-condition total RGB-to-mask times include live DINO and full selected head; setup, warmups, mask hashing and output serialization excluded. Descriptive local sample only; neither three-input average nor its ratio estimates whole-dataset latency/throughput.
external_evidence.head_segment_scope: Measured within each actual RGB chain using fresh O24 in RAM. Includes input metadata verification, RGB/reference-mask reload/preprocessing, semantic providers and final CRF when requested. Excludes DINO, output transfer, raw NPZ I/O, setup, and mask hashing.
limits: Three selected inputs and two paired rounds are descriptive local latency, not dataset-wide throughput.
The head API reloads/reprocesses RGB/reference mask; this equal overhead is included for both modes.
Cached-R retains only one freshly encoded reference tensor in RAM per case.
No comparison to archived masks is made; fresh encoder outputs are preserved through the real readouts and recorded by mask SHA.
One-time setup, warmups, mask hashing, report writing and output serialization are excluded.

timing.scope: Production clocks are cached-O24/source or mask-generation measurements. Never sum independent source clocks into a claimed final latency; use matched complete-pipeline evidence, distinguishing cached-O24 from actual RGB encoding.
